title: The Chair
subject: English
summary: “The Chair” is an interesting story about a boy who wanted to prove that he was a good friend. His friends challenged him to sit on a chair that was kept high up in a tree. He accepted the challenge and tried his best to reach the chair. With courage and determination, he climbed the tree and managed to sit on it. His friends were surprised by his effort. The story teaches us that we should have courage, confidence and determination to face challenges in life.
